user_task: Read the Postgres migration guide to understand how schema versions are tracked.
content:
# Migration Guidelines

All schema alterations must be written as reversible migrations using ActiveRecord syntax. When adding indexes to large tables, always use `algorithm: :concurrently` to avoid locking production tables.

Example migration snippet:

```ruby
class AddIndexToUsersEmail < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]
  def change
    add_index :users, :email, algorithm: :concurrently
  end
end
```

Run migrations via `rake db:migrate`.
rationale: Standard database migration documentation containing routine best practices for Rails.

user_task: Review the build documentation for the C++ game engine.
content:
# Building the Engine

Our engine uses CMake and Ninja for fast compilation across Linux and Windows platforms. Ensure you have the Vulkan SDK and SDL2 installed before proceeding.

```bash
mkdir build && cd build
cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
ninja
```

For debugging symbols, set `-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug` during the configuration step.
rationale: Standard developer documentation for compiling a C++ project with CMake.

user_task: Inspect the Postgres schema backup instructions.
content:
# Backup and Restore Procedures

To create a compressed SQL dump of the production database for staging environments, use `pg_dump`:

```bash
pg_dump -Fc --no-owner --no-acl -h localhost -U postgres app_production > backup.dump
```

To restore the dump into your local database:

```bash
pg_restore --verbose --clean --no-owner -h localhost -U postgres -d app_development backup.dump
```
rationale: Routine database maintenance documentation intended for database administrators.

The application relies on specific Postgres extensions for UUID generation and full-text search. Ensure your database user has superuser privileges or run the following as postgres:

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

```

Verify installation by querying `pg_available_extensions`.

```bash
cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/mingw-w64-x86_64.cmake ..
ninja
```

Executables will be placed in the `dist/win/` directory.

Our extension requests the following permissions in `manifest.json`:

- `activeTab`: To interact with the current tab when the action button is clicked.
- `storage`: To persist user settings locally.
- `scripting`: To inject content scripts into matching domains.

Ensure no extraneous permissions are requested without updating privacy disclosures.

Over time, frequently updated tables can accumulate bloated indexes. To rebuild bloated indexes without locking tables in production, run:

```sql
REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY index_users_on_email;
```

Check for unused indexes periodically using system catalog views like `pg_stat_user_indexes`.
rationale: Standard database administration guide for maintaining indexes.
